pages.text: $(0)Thou art cordially bidden to the 'Secluded Cottage'$(br)$(br)$(0)Here no war-drums sound, nor banners fly.$(br)$(0)Only a once-great leader doth dwell, awaiting a worthy soul.$(br)$(br)$(0)He was the Empire's earliest follower,$(br)$(0)Yet now he steers his own fate alone.$(br)$(0)His wand, which once charged forth for the Empire,$(br)$(0)Now serves but to test and guide the wayward youth.

$(0)If thou wouldst lend thine ear, he shall brew thee a cup of tea,$(br)$(0)And tell thee tales never writ in history:$(br)$(0)Of the secret arts of the Soul Ruby,$(br)$(0)Of that unhindered flight through the night,$(br)$(0)Of why he chose this hermit's life$(br)$(0)Rather than tread once more that cold, blood-soaked strife.$(br)$(br)$(0)The door stands ajar.$(br)$(0)Enter with grace and courtesy.$(br)$(0)He no longer feareth death,$(br)$(0)He only cherisheth this hard-won peace.$(br)$(br)$(0)— The Owner of the Secluded Cottage
